question: ThreeWheeler bi gan nham thanh Car lap lai 5 lan trong slice B4-dense khi QA - co nen sua tung box hay xu ly o cap rule?
decision: De xuat patch guideline R04 (bo sung dac diem hinh dang phan biet ThreeWheeler/Car) thay vi tu sua tung box ho tuan; ghi escalation ticket va bao annotator goc tu soat lai.
rationale: Mau loi lap lai co he thong (5/8 vehicle box sai class trong cung slice), khong phai loi ngau nhien mot lan; rule R04 hien chi liet ke ten loai xe, khong mo ta dac diem nhan dien nen de nham khi xe bi che/chup xa.
